observedDeclarations.generatedRuntimeRouteCount: not provable without boot/import; Filament auth/dashboard/resource/Livewire/vendor routes are generated

findings.detail: Static declarations are not a complete deployed route manifest; framework-generated auth, dashboard, resource, Livewire and vendor routes require a controlled artifact or boot-time manifest.
Resource discovery exposes create/edit/page behavior across operational models, but a closed action/field/role/effect inventory was not established under read-only constraints.
Source declarations under /opt are not cryptographically bound to the running PHP/FPM/queue artifact, generated route cache, migrations or Nginx upstream.
MFA middleware and an AdminAudit helper are present, but complete durable audit coverage for generated Livewire/resource actions and rollback/reconciliation is not demonstrated.

knownBlockers: production key registry/trusted time/revocation/replay controls not established
interpretation: Read-only declaration inventory only; no Laravel boot, route listing, authentication, customer data access, admin action, deployment or production mutation occurred. E0.3 remains first unmet and BLOCKED_OWNER; E0.4 remains non-production IN_PROGRESS.
